T: Road trip to Hollywood, snacks for the whole way.
D: Two slackers from New Jersey head to Hollywood to stop a movie being made about them.
P: Serve the banana splits when Suzanne the orangutan makes her escape.
S: thumbing a ride across the country
Sharp cheddar and pepper jack cut into cubes with crackers, salami and pickles, packed into a box for the road.
the craft service table in Hollywood
Pineapple, melon, strawberries and grapes cut and laid out on a big platter with a honey yoghurt dip.
home turf before the road trip
Pork roll sliced and fried until curled, stacked in slider buns with American cheese and mustard.
M: the fast food stop on the way west
Two smashed beef patties with cheese, pickles and sauce on toasted buns, wrapped in paper.
Triple-decker toasted sandwiches with chicken, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, cut in quarters with chips on the side.
W: Suzanne, the orangutan they bust out
Bananas split lengthways with vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream, nuts and a cherry.
K: the drinks machine at the Quick Stop
Raspberry cordial blended with plenty of ice and a squeeze of lemon until slushy, served in big cups with straws.

s.note: thumbing a ride across the country
s.how: Cut 150g sharp cheddar and 150g pepper jack into cubes. Slice 100g salami and 4 dill pickles. Pack into a box or onto a board with 1 box crackers, the kind of spread you could eat in the back of a stranger's car.

s.note: the craft service table in Hollywood
s.how: Cut half a pineapple and half a rockmelon into wedges, halve 250g strawberries and snip 300g grapes into small bunches. Arrange on a big platter. Mix 250g Greek yoghurt with 2 tbsp honey for dipping and keep it all chilled until serving.

m.note: the fast food stop on the way west
m.how: Roll 600g beef mince into 8 balls and smash flat on a smoking griddle, season and cook 2 minutes. Flip, add American cheese and cook 1 minute more. Stack 2 patties per toasted bun with pickles and 4 tbsp mayonnaise mixed with tomato sauce, then wrap in paper.

w.note: Suzanne, the orangutan they bust out
w.how: Split 4 bananas lengthways into 4 dishes. Add a scoop each of vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream for hot fudge and pour over. Top with whipped cream, chopped peanuts and a cherry.

d.note: the drinks machine at the Quick Stop
d.how: Blend 200ml raspberry cordial with 600g ice, 200ml cold water and the juice of 1 lemon until smooth and slushy. Pour into 4 big cups and serve straight away with straws.
